text:
Situation: Corvale General holds 87 vials of gemcitabine hydrochloride 2 g/52.6 mL with 31 days on hand at 2.8 vials per day. Corvale Lakeside holds 13 vials of the same presentation with 13.5 days on hand at 1 vial per day.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show gemcitabine hydrochloride is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers near-term needs at both sites. Lakeside's lower days on hand warrants proactive purchasing to avoid a gap. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place initial replenishment orders with Avyxa Pharma, LLC for both sites; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. If Avyxa cannot fulfill, buyer to order from Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. If needed, buyer to order from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. If needed, buyer to order from Gland Pharma Limited; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
5. If needed, buyer to order from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc.; requires Pharmacy Director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or dose rounding at this time.
